title: Create src/lib/template-engine.ts
description: Create a template processing module that reads template files, replaces {{PLACEHOLDER}} tokens with provided values, and writes output files to a destination directory. Binary files must be copied without token replacement.
acceptanceCriteria: processTemplate(src, dest, vars) function is exported
{{TOKEN}} placeholders are replaced with corresponding values from vars map
Multiple occurrences of the same token are all replaced
Binary files (images, fonts) are copied without modification
.tmpl extension is stripped from output filenames

steps.details: Create src/lib/template-engine.ts. Define a binary file extension list: ['.png', '.jpg', '.jpeg', '.gif', '.ico', '.woff', '.woff2', '.ttf', '.eot', '.pdf']. Create isBinaryFile(filePath: string): boolean that checks the extension.

Add: function replaceTokens(content: string, vars: Record<string, string>): string. Use a regex replacement: for each key in vars, replace all occurrences of `{{KEY}}` in the content. Use a global regex: `new RegExp('\\{\\{' + key + '\\}\\}', 'g')`.

Add: export async function processTemplate(srcDir: string, destDir: string, vars: Record<string, string>): Promise<void>. Walk srcDir recursively (use fs-extra's walk or recursive readdir). For each file: compute dest path (strip .tmpl ext, replace .gitignore.tmpl -> .gitignore). If binary: fs.copy(). Otherwise: read as utf-8, replaceTokens, write to dest.

Special case: files named '.gitignore.tmpl' must become '.gitignore' in the output. This is needed because git ignores .gitignore files in template directories. Handle this in the destination path computation.
Before writing each output file, call fs.ensureDir(path.dirname(destPath)) to create any missing parent directories. fs-extra's ensureDir is idempotent.

technicalNotes: Use fs-extra (not native fs) for copy, ensureDir, and readdir operations
The token format {{KEY}} uses curly braces — escape them properly in RegExp: '\\{\\{' + key + '\\}\\}'
Test with both text and binary files to verify binary files are not corrupted
